# Todos

> Todos is the task-driven workspace for humans and agents. Command a whole team through a single agent: assign models and roles, work in parallel, and deliver efficiently.

Todos is a minimal product workspace for humans and agents, organized around tasks: the Chief breaks your goal into todos, assigns each to the right agent, tracks progress, and reports back — and past tasks stay searchable. You set the goal and make the key decisions, pushing several things forward with very little of your attention.
